title: Spec
description: One unit of planned work: durable context, plus an optional ordered list of issues. Written by /to-spec (without issues), populated by /to-issues, executed one issue per iteration by loop.sh. Everything here is written once and read many times, so every field is chosen for what a fresh agent needs in a context window that contains nothing else.

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier for the effort. Must match the containing directory name.

summary.description: What this effort changes and why, in 1-3 sentences. INJECTED INTO EVERY LOOP ITERATION — keep it short enough that repeating it costs nothing.

context.description: Long-form background: research, provenance, rejected alternatives, links. NOT injected into loop iterations. Written for humans and for /to-issues, which reads it once when decomposing.

invariants.description: Rules that hold for every issue in this effort, phrased as absolutes an implementer can violate ('Sleeper player_id is the canonical player PK', 'no DB migrations'). INJECTED INTO EVERY ITERATION. Aim for 3-6.

out_of_scope.description: Adjacent work this effort deliberately does not do. INJECTED INTO EVERY ITERATION — this is the main defence against scope bleed.

verification.description: Shell commands that must pass before an issue counts as done ('npm test', 'npm run build'). INJECTED INTO EVERY ITERATION.

open_questions.description: Unresolved decisions. Not injected. /to-issues should resolve or explicitly defer these before writing issues.

issues.description: Ordered by priority: the loop picks the FIRST issue whose blockers are all done. Absent until /to-issues runs; loop.sh fails loudly if it is missing or empty.

ledger.description: Append-only record of completed issues, written by loop.sh from each iteration's DONE promise. INJECTED INTO EVERY ITERATION so a later issue learns what an earlier one built without reading its ticket.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identity, unique within the spec. Used in blocked_by, in the ledger, and in the agent's DONE promise.

title.description: One line, imperative. Shown on the board and in the prompt.

status.description: Owned by loop.sh, never by the implementing agent. 'claimed' means an iteration started it and did not report done — it is re-picked on the next pass. Blocked is derived from blocked_by, not stored.

blocked_by.description: Ids of issues that must be done first. Empty array means immediately workable.

body.description: Path to the prose body, relative to the spec directory: issues/<id>.md. Null when the criteria say everything and no rationale is needed.

files.description: Paths or directories the implementer should start from, to skip a discovery phase.

criteria.description: Observable conditions that define done. The single source of truth — never duplicated into the body file. Injected verbatim as the ticket's definition of done.

outcome.description: One line: what now exists that did not before, named concretely enough for a later issue to use it.
